mapper.select: SELECT id, plant_id, user_id, symptoms, report, feedback, created_at FROM diagnosis_record WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis_record(plant_id, user_id, symptoms, report, feedback, created_at) VALUES(#{plantId}, #{userId}, #{symptoms}, #{report}, #{feedback}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE diagnosis_record SET plant_id=#{plantId}, user_id=#{userId}, symptoms=#{symptoms}, report=#{report}, feedback=#{feedback} WHERE id=#{id}
